intro: Outside work, I play tennis with friends, follow cricket, hike, and listen to music. I also cook, travel when I can, try new things, and take on small DIY projects in the backyard when I have free time.
whatFuelsMe: I bring the same energy from my hobbies into building products every day. Whether I'm playing tennis, working on a DIY project, or solving a coding problem, I enjoy learning and creating.
